name: 8x8 LED dot matrix, common anode (788BS, 20 mm)

provenance.notes: Pin map, circuit and package: Shanghai Toplite TOP-CA-788BS technical data sheet (2014 revision), page 2 of 6, section 4 "Package dimensions and circuit diagram". ROW 1 to 8 are pins 9, 14, 8, 12, 1, 7, 2, 5 and COL 1 to 8 are pins 13, 3, 4, 10, 6, 11, 15, 16; each LED has its anode on the row line and its cathode on the column line (common anode), so a dot lights with its row high and its column low. Ratings (page 3): VF 1.80 / 2.10 / 2.40 V (min / typical / max) at 20 mA, DC IF 30 mA per dot, peak IF 120 mA at 1/10 duty, PD 80 mW per dot, VR 5 V. Body 20.0 +/- 0.25 mm square and 5.9 +/- 0.25 mm high, dots 1.9 mm diameter on a 2.5 mm pitch, 15.0 +/- 0.25 mm between the two pin rows, leads 0.45 mm diameter and 3.5 +/- 0.5 mm long. Pin 1 is at the bottom left of the dot field in the top view with the label side at the bottom; SunFounder's outline (image84) shows pins 1 to 8 along the label side and pins 9 to 16 back along the opposite side (pin 16 at top left, pin 9 at top right), which gives the usual counter-clockwise numbering used here. The datasheet drawing itself marks only pin 1 and the circuit-diagram pin numbers, so the numbering of pins 9 to 16 comes from the SunFounder outline. Geometry caveat: the real pin pitch is 2.5 mm (7 x 2.5 = 17.5 mm) and the row spacing is 15.0 mm, against 2.54 mm and 15.24 mm on the breadboard grid, so this model snaps 8 pins to 7 breadboard pitches (17.78 mm) and the rows to 6 pitches; the 0.28 mm and 0.24 mm differences are small, but fit on a real breadboard was not checked. Kit status: the component-list image shows "20mm Dot Matrix Module x1" marked 788BS, and SunFounder page 1.1.3 says "In this kit, we use a CA type (labeled as 788BS)". SunFounder's row and column pin tables agree exactly with the Toplite circuit diagram. The kit module's manufacturer is not stated, so Toplite is a same-marking datasheet and not a confirmed source part; its VF and current figures are Toplite's super-red chip.
